periods.label: Project Description: Implemented a digital onboarding platform to automate KYC and streamline account opening.

entry.text: Project Description: Implemented a digital onboarding platform to automate KYC and streamline account opening.
• Conducted Enterprise Analysis, Business Case, Stakeholder Analysis, and prepared the RACI Matrix.
• Gathered and documented requirements; prepared BRD, FRD, and supported SRS with technical teams.
• Created UML diagrams, wireframes, and process flows using MS Visio, Balsamiq, and Axure.
• Maintained RTM, coordinated UAT, and obtained business sign-off for successful implementation.
• Managed banking operations, led a team of 12+ associates, and supported client onboarding and KYC compliance.
